271: — All eight days of Hanukkah we recite the complete Hallel. Rem"a: And all eight days of Hanukkah we do not say Tachanun, Tzidkatekha Tzedek, Lamenatzeiach or Justification of [Divine] Judgment, [and] also on Hanukkah Eve in the afternoon prayer. And see above Section 131. (Mahari"l and Book of Customs)
